title: Men in Black interrogation about the control panel at DIA

tellings.quote: it. And the guy over to the side slapped his leg and said, "So that's it."

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says that in the late 1980s at the Defense Intelligence Agency, the US military's intelligence service, he was questioned by mysterious men about a control panel, the kind of thing he connects to operating a UFO. He tells it as something that happened to him, and mentions a colleague named Ed Dames. Buchanan says that when he gave his answer, a man sitting off to the side slapped his leg and said, "So that's it," as if Buchanan had solved something they had been stuck on.
